records.method: Cr-51 radiotracer in CrF2-bearing NaF-ZrF4; thermal-convection loop; Arrhenius fit to DeVan Table XVI total-specimen diffusivities
records.source: J. H. DeVan, Effect of Alloying Additions on Corrosion Behavior of Nickel-Molybdenum Alloys in Fused Fluoride Mixtures, M.S. thesis, University of Tennessee, 1960.
records.notes: Fit uses the 15 directly tabulated Loop 1248 diffusivities from Table XVI. DeVan treats the governing coefficient as a phenomenological bulk/effective diffusivity and reports that grain-boundary diffusion becomes important only in the deepest portions of the tracer profiles. No separate GB Arrhenius correlation is published in the thesis.
